persona: Hobby guitarist who understands pitches and rhythm but has never produced music on a computer; no prior RILL knowledge.
goal: Create a short bass riff and a second higher melody using included instruments, adjust their balance, save and export the idea.

outcome.status: Mostly completed; audition blocked/confounded by audio environment
outcome.created: Four-bar C minor sketch at 112 BPM, with existing Circuit drums, newly added R1 Mini Rubber Bass and R1 Mini Sync Lead.
outcome.bass: One-bar C2, C2, D#2, G2 quarter-note riff repeated across four bars.
outcome.melody: Two-bar eight-note C4, D#4, G4, A#4, G4, C5, A#4, G4 phrase repeated twice.
outcome.balance: Visually set drums -10 dB, bass -2.5 dB, lead -8 dB; not judged by hearing.

chronological_discoveries.observation: Add track > Add instrument track is readily visible. Browser has three built-in choices, but names do not immediately identify a bass sound.
R1 Mini preset menu offers clear Bass and Lead categories; presets provide a path through otherwise unfamiliar synthesis controls.
Adding an instrument automatically creates a one-bar New pattern. Double-clicking it opens rename, while right-click Edit notes opens the piano editor.
Pencil tool hint explains note drawing and dragging for duration. Mouse wheel reaches bass register; displayed note names confirm chosen pitches.
Duplicate is a tool activated before clicking the desired clip; its inline hint made this clear after first click had not duplicated anything.
Drawing melody notes beyond the existing clip end extends the clip automatically to two bars.
Audio failure banner offers Details, Retry playback, and Audio setup; switching the output briefly advanced transport but the failure returned.
Mixer faders and editable numeric values make provisional balance changes straightforward.
Save as updates project title; Export audio displays duration, uses project filename/folder, and confirms completion.
Mixer channel header context menu has Rename. Blue track color carries through to bass clips.

issues.title: Opening a new pattern led to renaming before note entry
steps: Click Keyboard in resulting rename form.
issues.expected: Open the pattern to enter musical notes; Keyboard might show musical keys.
issues.observed: Double-click opened a rename form. Keyboard showed a typing keyboard. Edit notes was discovered in context menu after roughly one minute.
issues.recovery: Right-click > Edit notes. Subsequent melody editing used that route directly.
issues.confidence: high for observed behavior and participant detour; simulated novice expectation

issues.title: Bass/lead choice requires opening a technically dense instrument panel
steps: Inspect built-in R1 Drums, R1 Mini, R1 Sampler.
Choose R1 Mini and Add instrument track.
issues.expected: Find a plainly named bass sound among included instruments.
issues.observed: Browser names alone did not communicate bass suitability. New panel initially showed Custom with many oscillator/filter/envelope controls. Bass and Lead names became clear in preset dropdown. Browser also said 0 plug-ins while All plug-ins showed 3.
issues.recovery: Preset dropdown provided Bass Rubber Bass and Lead Sync Lead.
issues.confidence: high for visible content; medium for impact beyond this persona

issues.title: Loop this clip meaning differed from expected phrase repetition
steps: Choose Loop this clip while wanting a repeating bass phrase.
issues.expected: Create or expose repeated phrase blocks across arrangement.
issues.observed: Green playback range shortened to one bar; the arrangement still contained one bass clip.
issues.recovery: Used Duplicate tool and its visible instruction to create three additional bars.
issues.confidence: high for observed result; medium for terminology interpretation

issues.title: Audio output failures blocked reliable audition
issues.classification: environment-confounded; do not treat as established RILL defect
steps: Later respond to Audio output stream failed banner.
Choose Retry playback, Details, Audio setup.
Switch System default to visible Rill lab paced output and Apply.
issues.expected: Hear composition and see advancing playhead.
issues.observed: Initial Pause state stayed at 0:00.00. Later banner reported ALSA I/O error (5). Alternate output advanced to 0:00.83 then failed again.
issues.recovery: Continued composition visually; saved and exported successfully. Reliable audition remained unresolved.
issues.confidence: high for UI failure and limited transport; cause unassigned

issues.title: Track name typing after native file picker was ignored
issues.classification: environment-confounded; coordinator identified Xvfb focus issue
steps: After native save/export dialogs, double-click mixer bass header.
Open Track tab and click Name.
Type Rubber bass using physical keys.
issues.expected: Name field changes to entered text.
issues.observed: Name remained R1 Mini. Keyboard button opened a rename form where typing and Apply name succeeded. Coordinator reported keyboard focus on Xvfb root after native pickers and corrected driver.
issues.recovery: Keyboard rename form; later direct context-menu Rename worked.
issues.confidence: high that typing was ignored; low as application finding due known focus confound

successes: Added two built-in instruments without documentation.
Used musically labeled presets to obtain bass and lead roles.
Created intentional pitches and rhythmic durations with mouse drags.
Extended a clip naturally by drawing beyond its endpoint.
Built four-bar arrangement through visible Duplicate tool.
Adjusted three track levels with faders and precise numeric entry.
Renamed tracks and colored bass for easier identification.
Saved editable project and exported WAV through native UI with success feedback.
unresolved_questions: How does this arrangement actually sound and is the provisional balance musically appropriate?
Was export-banner Play supposed to preview in RILL or launch another player? It disappeared with no other visible change.
Does the exported WAV contain the intended full musical result? UI success and nonzero file size were verified, but no listening judgment was made.

saved_artifacts.verification: Save as title change, later Ctrl+S cleared unsaved marker; file exists with nonzero size
Exported confirmation banner, file exists with nonzero size

limitations: This is a simulated novice participant, not an empirical human interview.
Actions were chosen from native screenshots only. No source, tests, repository docs beyond mandatory AGENTS.md, application internals, other participant findings, or headless music edits were used.
Started with provided Midnight circuit project containing a drum loop; task was not tested from completely empty project.
No audio was personally heard or evaluated. Coordinator separately reported nonzero recording signal, which is insufficient to establish correct musical playback.
Audio output failure and Xvfb keyboard focus issue confound audition and some input observations.
First loop-range drag ended short of target; second reached bar five. Coordinate/drag mechanics may contribute, so this is not presented as a confirmed application bug.
Final project was saved after track name/color changes. WAV was exported before those non-audio changes; musical content and level settings match.
Artifact existence/size listing at end was bookkeeping only; project internals and exported audio contents were not inspected.
